description: Delegates one sending subdomain of the clinic's domain (for example care.yourclinic.com) to Oben's DNS servers, so Oben can publish and maintain the clinic's email authentication records (DKIM, SPF via a custom MAIL FROM, DMARC) on that subdomain only. Nothing else on the domain changes.
variableDescription: host: the sending subdomain word chosen in Oben (never the bare domain or www). ns1-ns4: the four name servers of the Oben-managed zone created for that subdomain.
